correctness.rationale: The exact iterated fixed-point counts follow from the cyclic Galois fixed fields and multiplicative and additive Hilbert 90. The order proof distinguishes the classes, and surjective norm and trace maps give exact coefficient-fiber counts; all parameters including characteristic dividing extension degree are covered. A standard-library exhaustive test checked all 28,076 coefficient pairs in fifteen independent finite-field cases. Computation supplements but does not replace the quantified proof.

value.rationale: The problem is a natural, complete parameter-space classification of a standard family of permutation polynomials. The exact number of graph-isomorphism types, every cycle count, and exact number of polynomial coefficient pairs for each profile give usable enumeration and selection data. It is not an arbitrary finite calculation or merely a special numerical parameter substitution.
